B0G6ZH853W.title: Aqara Multi-State Sensor P100, Door and Window & Vibration Sensor, White
bullets: 2-in-1 Sensor with Dual-Protocol Compatibility: The P100 is a versatile 2-in-1 sensor, combining door/window and object monitoring in one. It supports both Thread and Zigbee protocols with Matter compatibility to connect with Apple Home, Home Assistant, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Homey. (*Matter requires a corresponding Thread Border Router and Matter Controller). Note: Thread protocol offers only Open/Close Monitoring. Zigbee protocol (Aqara Hub required) unlocks full features including Object Monitoring. Only one mode can be active at a time.

Hassle-Free Open / Close Monitoring: In Open/Close Monitoring Mode, the Multi-State Sensor P100 accurately detects the status of hinged doors, casement windows, hopper windows, composite windows, refrigerators, safes, and more. Its single-body design eliminates the alignment hassle of traditional two‑piece magnetic sensors, ensuring reliable detection even if doors/windows sag over time. Ideal for home security and energy‑saving automations.

Context-Aware Object Monitoring : Switch to Object Monitoring Mode in the Zigbee protocol (requires an Aqara hub) to unlock comprehensive event detection: orientation (horizontal/vertical/tilt), movement, fall, vibration, and triple tap. Perfect for securing valuables, monitoring drawers, detecting glass breaking, or caring for elders and pets. Get precise alerts based on what actually happened, not just generic motion. (Note: Supported only in the Aqara Home App via Zigbee mode; cannot be bridged to third-party Matter platforms.)

Easy Installation & Smart Calibration: The Multi-State Sensor P100's one‑piece design sticks to almost any flat surface. Quickly press the top button of the device three times to complete manual calibration. Choose from 10 adjustable sensitivity levels to match your environment, and customize reporting intervals (5s to 5min) in Zigbee mode. Its AI self‑learning algorithm continuously corrects minor drift over time, ensuring long‑term accuracy and reducing false alerts. (Indoor use only; avoid direct rain exposure.)

Long Battery Life & Detailed Event History: Designed with ultra-low power consumption, the Multi-State Sensor P100 offers a long battery life. In Aqara Home (Zigbee mode), all events are logged with clear charts and statistics, helping you track patterns and spot anomalies. Thread mode provides open/close notifications via your Matter platform. Perfect for creating smarter, data‑driven automations. (Note: Zigbee2MQTT and comparable third-party USB dongles are not officially supported by Aqara. Full product functionality may be limited or unavailable.)
